description: Use this when the user wants to split a PDF into several files, break a PDF into parts, extract page ranges as separate PDFs, split in groups of N pages, or save each page as its own PDF. Takes one attached PDF and one of: ranges (each item becomes one file, e.g. ["1-3", "4-end"]), every_n_pages, or each_page. Returns a ZIP of up to 50 PDFs, plus separate links when there are 10 parts or fewer, and checks each part's page count. Does not open password-protected PDFs and flattens form fields. Do not use for combining several PDFs (use merge_pdfs).

each_page.description: true: one PDF per page, e.g. true.

every_n_pages.description: Make a new file in groups of N pages, e.g. 2.

file.description: The PDF to split, e.g. handbook.pdf.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

ranges.description: One item per output file, e.g. ["1-4", "5-12", "13-end"]. An item may list several ranges: "1-2, 9".

name: split_pdf
title: Split a PDF
